name: redgate
description: Jordan's default operating protocol for nontrivial planning, research, design, building, debugging, refactoring, review, deployment, multi-agent coordination, and risky external actions. Calibrates trivial work to a direct response; routes larger work through ARM/TRACE/JUDGE with PATCH/MINOR/MAJOR autonomy. Uses the interactive ask-question tool for tap-ready decisions and confirmations instead of long prose questionnaires.
